title: Right-Sizing LLM-Agent Decomposition in VAT Determination: A Pilot Controlled Sweep
research_delta: Holds a bounded VAT activity surface and orchestrator fixed while varying worker partitioning, then tests token-budget and injected-failure alternatives against repository-precommitted falsification criteria.
main_caveat: No headline comparison survived Holm correction; token matching remained inconclusive, and content-fault comparisons are confounded by when corruption enters each partition's handoffs.

title: Natural-Language Workflows Are Not Software Yet: Artifact-Driven Compilation for Reliable Agent Execution
research_delta: Compiles textual procedures into explicit artifact reads and writes, deterministic control transfers, local gates, and versioned retry state.
main_caveat: The packaged compiler changes decomposition, routing, gates, and retries together; semantic equivalence remains model-judged and total execution or repair cost is unreported.

title: TRACE: Agentic Catalog Enrichment with Multi-source Evidence Grounding
research_delta: Separates multi-source catalog evidence collection, candidate normalization, independent review, and write authorization before attributes reach production.
main_caveat: The deployed four-verdict policy publishes UNVERIFIED values and has no Scout-only or matched single-agent control, so the Judge and multi-agent contributions are not isolated.

title: Auditable by Construction: An Ontology-Driven Framework for Trustworthy LLM Analytics in Enterprise Finance
research_delta: Makes company eligibility and complete filing-to-evidence provenance explicit in enterprise-finance retrieval, separating citation traceability from answer correctness.
main_caveat: The gold-derived candidate pool is small, answer correctness does not improve over BM25, and a matched sparse entity-filter control is absent.

title: Bolo: Verified Model Hub for Next-Generation AI Databases
research_delta: Combines bounded repository repair, clean-environment execution, and static target-model/input/output dataflow checks before publishing an inference template.
main_caveat: The current gate verifies runnability and limited program structure, not task-specific output behavior or semantic correctness, and selected Type III gains cost about 2.5 times the control.

title: An LLM agent for end-to-end computational materials discovery
research_delta: Connects literature and structure curation, deterministic scientific tools, multi-fidelity screening, review gates, and provenance into one replayable computational campaign.
main_caveat: No matched single-agent or scripted pipeline isolates orchestration, total compute is unreported, and the selected materials have computational rather than experimental validation.

title: Bringing analytic rigor to agentic AI for science: The Brain Researcher platform for neuroimaging data analysis
research_delta: Places method constraints, immutable execution bundles, multiverse analysis, scientific claim review, and gated memory writeback inside one governed research episode.
main_caveat: The headline control removes the registry, knowledge graph, and constraints together, verified grounding remains 22%, and automated review missed a material directionality error.

title: Scientific Data Skills: Enabling Agent-Ready Scientific Data Services at Scale
research_delta: Packages one dataset snapshot's scientific context, file semantics, operating guidance, checks, and provenance as a routable reusable agent interface.
main_caveat: The winning condition changes discipline routing, registration, and curated information together; actual dataset invocation, executed checks, drift, and scaled maintenance are not evaluated.

title: SkillEffect: Checked Lowering for Memory-Bounded Agent Tools
research_delta: Moves memory safety for recognized deterministic data programs to the tool-dispatch boundary, where an independent checker rebuilds a bounded intermediate representation before an audited implementation receives execution authority.
main_caveat: The guarantee depends on manually engineered relation plugins and does not automatically optimize arbitrary agent code; certification can also duplicate input scans.

title: StagedWorkspace: A Versioned Workspace for Knowledge-Work Agents
research_delta: Treats the evolving workspace as authoritative state and exposes both parsed retrieval views and native artifacts, with content-hash bindings and review diffs.
main_caveat: The matched read ablation isolates dual-view access, not content-hash version synchronization itself; ingestion and sandbox costs are excluded.

title: Polaris: Multi Agentic System for Conversational Enterprise Analytics
research_delta: Supervisor-led analytics with dynamic online assignment across specialized querying, visualization, and reasoning agents.
main_caveat: The current evidence does not cleanly isolate multi-agent coordination from the rest of the system package.

title: Business Truth, not SQL Accuracy: A Rule-Gated 7B Analytics Agent Outperforms a Direct-Prompted 32B Baseline
research_delta: Moves analytics correctness from executable SQL toward business truth, clarification/abstention, schema-drift handling, and deterministic post-execution checks.
main_caveat: System scaffolding is unmatched across headline baselines and no component ablation isolates the deterministic verification layer.

title: CIPHER: A Decoupled Exploration-Selection Framework for Test-Time Scaling of Data Science Agents
research_delta: Decouples generation of multiple initial data-science plans from strategic selection and parallel execution.
main_caveat: Benefits must be interpreted together with added test-time branching and selection cost.

title: A Semantic-Layer-Mediated Agent for Natural Language to SQL over Heterogeneous Enterprise Databases
research_delta: Moves model reasoning from raw physical schemas to a curated semantic layer and compiles a compact semantic query into dialect-specific SQL deterministically.
main_caveat: System quality depends on semantic-layer coverage and curation cost; incomplete or incorrect semantic definitions remain a central failure mode.

title: APEX-SQL: Talking to the data via Agentic Exploration for Text-to-SQL
research_delta: Turns schema linking into a hypothesis-verification loop with active profiling of real data before SQL generation.
main_caveat: Exploration improves grounding but adds online data access and token cost that must be matched against stronger static-schema controls.

title: AgentSM: Semantic Memory for Agentic Text-to-SQL
research_delta: Stores prior database execution experience as interpretable semantic programs so later queries can reuse database-specific reasoning paths.
main_caveat: The key boundary is whether curated/retrieved semantic memory remains reliable under schema and workload drift.
